crossRefs.note: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.
“It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.
If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and…
What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?
For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’
Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,
You have said, ‘It is vain to serve God;’ and ‘What profit is it that we have followed his instructions, and that we…

translations.web: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’
translations.bsb: For you ask, ‘What does it profit me, and what benefit do I gain apart from sin?’
translations.kjv: For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? and, What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?
translations.asv: That thou sayest, What advantage will it be unto thee? And, What profit shall I have, more than if I had sinned?
